instruction: Owner approves SymbolicProofingLLM it3 training on the decomposition data: Owner 2026-10-01 (chat, verbatim): 'da, aprob, vei ce iese, pe moment daca LLM-urile judecator nu se oun de acird inseamna probabil ca exista ambiguitate scuzabile si orobabil si oamenii ar vedea problematice cazurile alea, e ok, facem ce putem, daca nu dureaza foarte mult merita it3'. Scope: one run symbolic-proofing-gemma270m-it3, Gemma 3 270M LoRA, data datasets/neuro_english/proofing-it3-decomp (3,246 train / 326 dev, plus the it2 data mix if the builder's design requires it), fast recipe (micro-batch 16 x accumulation 1), queued after the gloss run (one training at a time). Judge disagreement on S3/S4 is read as excusable ambiguity.

further_decisions.title: Owner allows parallel GPU training runs when faster than serial
Owner: the fallback base is Gemma 3 1B (LoRA), not Qwen
Owner: evaluate layer by layer; for now NL and grammatical analysis, not SOP translation
Incident: symbolic/neuro split used SOP match instead of the grammatical analysis (dataset membership is decided by the analysis layer)
Owner: remove Qwen3-1.7B from the chat; compare proofing LLMs only on our synthetic data and against their untrained base
Night loop (owner 2026-10-01: iterate until morning so both proofing LLMs are very good)
